notes: NYC's open-admission municipal shelter system; takes in and adopts out guinea pigs, rabbits and other small animals as well as cats and dogs. Rescues can pull at-risk animals through ACC's New Hope program. Also provides wildlife guidance and lost-and-found. Email: (see nycacc.org contact form)
